instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) ONLY. Do not create or rename files to .tsx.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
Maintain high contrast dark blue styling throughout with #0B132B / #1C2541 backgrounds and cyan/amber/emerald accents.
Include full support for PT-BR currency formatted as R$ 0,00.
Implement Sonner toasts for copy-to-clipboard (Pix code) and payment submission notifications.
Ensure fixed headers and mobile bottom navigation do not obscure page content by applying correct padding (e.g., pb-24 on main wrappers).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not center align the entire app container or use flat grey boxes. Use rich deep blue layers, subtle borders (#334155), and vibrant action accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Every interactive element MUST meet contrast standards with text-slate-100 or text-white on dark buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, and status badges MUST include data-testid attributes.
